# CodexBar source

Repository: https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar

Revision: `7447bc77c2497323d9c41e40164ce705533493c8`.

`Sources/Tobken/UsageMenuCardLayout.swift` is copied from CodexBar. Its MIT license
is retained here. Tobken uses a new compact AppKit/SwiftUI menu modeled on the
CodexBar layout; it does not claim to be the complete upstream CodexBar app.
